title: log.query
description: Query logs and timeline for forensic events using structured filters. Returns matching records with timestamps and sources.

case_id.description: UUID v4 case identifier from case.open.

q.description: Query string (no shell metacharacters). Alphanumeric, underscore, colon, period, equals, space, slash, asterisk, quote, apostrophe, hyphen only. Forbids: ; | ` $ & < >

source.description: Restrict query to specific log source type. Default: all.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 start timestamp. Matches only events on or after this time.

until.description: Optional ISO 8601 end timestamp. Matches only events on or before this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 1000.

inputSchema.description: Case and query string required; source, time range, and limit optional.

host.description: Hostname or machine name where event originated (null if N/A).

user.description: User account associated with event (null if N/A).

level.description: Event severity/level. Null if not applicable to source.

message.description: Event message or log entry text (max 4096 chars).

raw_offset.description: Byte offset in original log file (for audit trail).

total_matched.description: Total number of matches (may exceed returned hits if truncated).

truncated.description: True if results were truncated due to limit parameter.

outputSchema.description: Query results with event metadata and truncation indicator.

x-mcp-capability.name: log.query
x-mcp-capability.description: Query forensic timeline and logs with structured filters.
constraints: case_id must be valid UUID v4
q pattern strictly forbids shell metacharacters: ; | ` $ & < > (security gate)
q maxLength enforces 512-char limit (prevents log explosion)
source enum restricts to evtx, syslog, audit, or all
since/until must be valid ISO 8601 format
Only log2timeline, plaso-query, sigma subprocess permitted
truncated must reflect whether total_matched > returned hits
